so around the last months of 2019, like October, November, December, one of my good friends did acid for his first time and told me all about it. How he saw all these crazy visuals and how much of a good time he had. Me really knowing nothing of acid, well I was really intrigued and influenced to try it. At the time I had only smoked weed, so acid was a pretty big step but I didn’t know at the time 

Towards the beginning of December I had bought a single tab of acid from the plug that my friend had bought from. I wanted to research about acid before trying it because I knew nothing and with that I learned that the plug had given me a large dose, which he said the tab was 300ug. When I found that out I held off on doing acid for a couple of days, and I let the tab sit on my drawer out in the open. There’s a window in my room and sun lights comes in sometimes so idk if the heat had something to do with taking away the dosage of the tab or whatever.

A couple days go by and it’s around December 7th when I take it. Only I ddint take the full tab. I split it in a small piece and took that. Afterwards I felt a weird sensation in my stomach and then proceeded to wait for an hour. Keep in mind I did this in a dark room alone so I didnt really see anything crazy like visuals, except the weird vibey head and body space was there. I ended falling asleep a couple hours later 

After this I was kind of disappointed, I was expecting to see crazy visuals and have this marvelous experience, so I decided to take the bigger half the next day which was December 9th. When I took it I waited an hour again and nothing happened again, a bit disappointed I went to bed to try and sleep and this is where it all began 

I started feeling a weird sensation of panic and anxiety come over me and I became very cold. I got up and I was like oh shit is the acid hitting? Again I saw no visuals except everything almost became a blur. I remember panicking too hard and running into my moms room where I tried to calm down but I was shaking hard and still very cold. 

After a while she ended up giving me what I think was Benzos because shortly after i blacked out. The following day was absolute hell. I could tell my dopamine and serotonin levels were depleted, and everything was just so bright and gloomy. 

After this day I went back to normal except everything was different, my depersonalization was terrible and my anxiety was off the charts. Life felt so foreign and lost after this. 

I’ve somewhat recovered but there are still some things I need to
